origin.heading: How it started.
origin._note: TO CONFIRM: Hudson to confirm the founding anecdote. About 80 words, no 'most trusted', no numbers.
origin.body: Charis Creations began in 2013, when founder Tumusiime Hudson picked up a camera at a friend’s introduction ceremony in Kampala and saw that Uganda’s stories were not being told the way they deserved. What started as one person filming kukyala ceremonies and weddings grew into a studio of cinematographers, photographers, editors, drone pilots and directors, united by one belief: every frame matters.
